body:
Getting the team ID seems nontrivial: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/18727894/how-can-i-find-my-apple-developer-team-id-and-team-agent-apple-id

I'm not sure how well we can explain the procedure here.
In fact I looked up my team ID on developer.apple.com so I don’t know if there’s any better text. But I’m happy that it is now mentioned as a required parameter.

Team ID should be visible on the developer portal (membership details), see https://developer.apple.com/help/glossary/team-id

It should be the same as user id (in the certificate name) in most cases.
I've added a link to that page in the message.
